manifestations.invariant: After a reported fuel-entry error followed by service, the fuel series remains consistent and the reversal is recorded once.

contract_bindings.quote: The consumption auditor compares each settled fuel series to the odometer distance and records a variance when the series is no longer consistent.
The misfuel regression test expects one reversal as a compensating record, appended exactly once for each corrected delivery.
